vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate defaults this to null for security fixes.

customManagers.description: The Renovate image the renovate-config workflow validates this file with.

packageRules.description: pnpm is pinned in both mise.toml and packageManager; bump them in one PR, where the mise manager also relocks mise.lock.
Renovate publishes several times a day; bump the validator image weekly.
mise releases almost daily, some with breaking changes; bump it weekly.
browser-compat-data releases about weekly and only feeds test/build.spec.js's API floor check; take it once a week.
Raise an engines ceiling only after CI is green on the new major (see docs/toolchain.md); a major bump of the exact pin fails install until then.
Override targets are advisory floors, each on a chosen major. They move when an advisory does, not when a release lands. Majors only, so vulnerability alerts still reach them (see docs/toolchain.md).
